sinopsis.es: Sara Shahverdi, primera concejala electa de su pueblo iraní, entrena adolescentes en moto para detener matrimonios infantiles. Acusaciones ponen en crisis su identidad.
sinopsis.en: Sara Shahverdi, the first elected council member of her Iranian village, trains teenage girls in motorcycling to help stop child marriages. When accusations arise, her sense of identity is thrown into crisis.
